name: home-repair
summary: Repairers do plumbing, electrical and handyman jobs in people's homes.
description: Each job is paid once it is done; not renovations paid in stages.

description.description: The job, in the writer's words: what needs fixing, or what the repairer fixes, and how.

price.description: The price per hour, or for the whole job.

jobs.description: The kinds of job; mounting is fixing things to walls, such as shelves or a TV.

base.description: The area the repairer works in: anywhere in the circle.

hours.description: When the repairer works, each week.

time.description: When the job is wanted: a time, or a span to fit it in.

licences.description: Licences or certificates the repairer holds, each by name, such as for gas or electrical work; a word such as qualified alone goes in the description.

pastWork.description: Photos of jobs the repairer has done.

onTime.description: Whether the repairer came at the time agreed.

fixed.description: Whether the job was done as agreed.

paid.description: Whether the client paid as agreed, once the job was done.
